# Attempt 6: slice 1 done, slice 2 not started

Slice 1 (a test-only change is measured over the source it tests) is done:
RED 82, GREEN 87, regression 88, commit 75cea82, worked by seen-implementer on
sonnet. GREENs 83 and 85 were taken before two fixes changed the tree and are
superseded by 87; regressions 84 and 86 failed and led to those fixes.

The handoff pack written at record 88 says "2 of 2 slices done". That is the
pack's inference counting the three GREENs after one RED, not the work: slice 2
(report and kpi say not measured for a run that measured nothing; the Outcome
quotes only recorded figures, F3 and F4) has no RED yet. The next session works
slice 2 on sonnet at medium effort, as routed, citing a RED recorded after 87.

Departures in slice 1, for the review: source_files treats a sibling named in
the same path list as present even before it exists on disk (a plan naming
fees.ts and fees.test.ts maps the test to fees.ts, not the directory); the gate
tests for a test-only slice live in harness/tests/test_mutation.py, subclassing
test_stage_gates.MutationJournal, because test_stage_gates.py is not a slice file.
